cohort: Pregnant women between 14-21 weeks gestation diagnosed with antepartum iron deficiency anemia.
finding: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose leads to a quicker short-term elevation of hemoglobin, hematocrit, and ferritin levels compared to oral ferrous sulfate, though levels equalize in the long term, and it is safe and well-tolerated.
mod_finding: No significant difference in delivery patterns between treatment groups was observed.
